outcome: incidence of congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (CNDO)
cohort: 40 patients diagnosed with CNDO and treated with lacrimal probing between January 2011 and February 2013
finding: While CNDO was found less frequently among infants delivered vaginally compared to those delivered by cesarean section, this difference was not statistically significant.
mod_finding: Congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction was found less frequently among infants delivered vaginally compared to cesarean delivery, but this difference was not statistically significant.
